ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with layers labeled Producers, Herbivores, Carnivores and Omnivores, Scavengers, Detritivores. Lion is located in the Carnivores and Omnivores area on the left. The arrows connected near Lion point toward Lion, indicating that Lion eats other organisms; I do not see any arrow starting from Lion and pointing to Hyena, Vulture, Termites, Bacteria, Fungi, or any other labeled organism. Reasoning: According to the arrow rule in the diagram, if an organism eats Lion, there should be an arrow from Lion to that organism. There is no such arrow in the diagram, so no organism in this diagram feeds on Lion.
